messages:
Clara (partnerships): quick thread to align on Lisbon (pt-west1) rollout with marketplace + HW partner + local SI. target GA: Jun 15. who has blockers?
Tom (cloud-partners): we need a marketplace SKU mapping and entitlement for pt-west1, support from GCP partner ops. ETA from their side ~2 weeks if we have the SKU spec ready.
Nisha (eng-infra): capacity wise we can reserve 4xA10G-equivalent instances initially. need quota request punched by finance/cloud ops. no infra blockers otherwise.
Ravi (solutions): SI team (Porto Systems) can start integration testing next week. they asked for sample endpoints and CORS rules. I’ll share a test manifest.
Hugo (nvidia-partner): driver cert for the A10 variant is scheduled Fri. we can fast-track validation if you provide model bundle and perf target.
Marta (legal): short checklist: data residency addendum for PT, updated DPA for marketplace listing, privacy notice snippet. legal review ~5 business days after docs.
Ethan (prod-marketing): announcement: want a joint blog + social on GA day. need partner logos, approved quote from Hugo, and a 2‑line marketplace blurb by May 28 to get marketplace marketing push.
Clara (partnerships): action items I’ll consolidate: 1) SKU spec (Tom) 2) quota request (finance) 3) SI test manifest (Ravi) 4) driver bundle (Hugo) 5) DPA addendum (Marta) 6) marketing assets (Ethan). Ping me when each is ready.
Tom (cloud-partners): Clara re: SKU spec — draft below, pls confirm fields we need to add to marketplace portal:
```
{
  "sku_id": "rw-prod-pt-west1",
  "region": "pt-west1",
  "capacity_unit": "gpu-hours",
  "min_commit": "monthly",
  "entitlements": ["private-deploy","hosted-api"]
}
```
Ravi (solutions): that manifest looks good. for SI tests, we need a staging endpoint and a sample token with limited TTL. Clara can you request a staging token from eng-infra?
Nisha (eng-infra): staging token request acknowledged. I’ll create a short-lived service token and a routing rule for pt-west1 staging by EOD tomorrow.
Hugo (nvidia-partner): can you share model bundle constraints? memory/quantization targets? we want to make sure cert test reflects customers' expected configs.
Clara (partnerships): model bundle: prefer 8-bit quant, max 32k context, target p95 latency 250ms for single-stream. sending details to Hugo now.
Marta (legal): quick Q — are we storing logs in-region or replicating to eu-west1? residency affects DPA language.
Nisha (eng-infra): logs will be stored in pt-west1 for primary retention, replicated to eu-west1 only for DR after 30 days. should be fine but I’ll note replication in the DPA draft.
Ethan (prod-marketing): draft PR timeline: internal preview Jun 10, partner preview Jun 12, GA Jun 15. need final quotes by Jun 8.
Clara (partnerships): can someone own the marketplace legal submission? Marta?
Marta (legal): I can handle submission but need the full DPA text + customer-facing blurb. please route through legal-review channel.
Tom (cloud-partners): FYI GCP ops asked for expected QPS per region to provision load balancers. rough numbers: 100 r/s peak for first month, scale plan in place.
Ravi (solutions): noted. I’ll prepare a 1-page integration plan for Porto Systems with endpoints, sample calls, and expected error modes.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: pt-west1 staging infra will be provisioned at 2024-05-02T22:00Z (per infra pipeline).
Clara (partnerships): perfect. summary: everyone send deliverables to this thread + ping me once done. I’ll keep a rolling checklist and update the joint launch doc. Thanks :raised_hands:
Ethan (prod-marketing): tagging @Hugo — can you confirm partner quote by next Wed?
Hugo (nvidia-partner): yes, will provide approved quote by Wed.
Tom (cloud-partners): I’ll upload the SKU spec to the marketplace portal today and start entitlement ticket with partner ops.
Marta (legal): blocking items tracked. will post updates in thread.
Nisha (eng-infra): staging token created. DMing Ravi the creds.
Clara (partnerships): last ask — does anyone foresee compliance/regulatory blockers for PT telecom? call it out now.
Ravi (solutions): SI flagged telecom certifications for on-prem gateways, but nothing for hosted API. will capture in integration plan.
Clara (partnerships): awesome — closing for now. I’ll bump if we need a sync call. cheers everyone! :rocket:
